_comment: Curated catalog for the skill-finder skill. Used to recommend plugins/skills/agents the user has NOT installed yet, ranked by rating. RULES: (1) Add ONLY real, installable entries you have verified — never invent repos or star counts. (2) `rating` is 0-100, normally derived from GitHub stars at `rated_on`; refresh via live search. (3) `install` must be the exact command(s) a user runs. The skill-finder skill treats this file as an overlay on top of live web/GitHub search results, so it stays useful even while sparse.

plugins.name: agent-router
plugins.description: Discovers installed skills/agents and routes any task to the best one; ships skill-finder for discovering new ones.
